title: Final comma comparison over a localized fibrant object
statement:
Use ordinary nerves, quasicategories, equivalences and coherent functor categories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in fixed universes enlarged so that all indexing categories below are small. Let $\mathcal A$ be an ordinary category with terminal object $1$, and $W,P$ classes of arrows containing all isomorphisms and closed under composition. Suppose $W$ has two-out-of-three. An object $a$ is fibrant if $a\to1$ lies in $P$; let $\mathcal A_f$ be the full subcategory of such objects. Assume that pullbacks of $p:x\to y$ in $P$ between fibrant objects along any $y'\to y$ with $y'$ fibrant exist, are fibrant, and have projection to $y'$ in $P$, also in $W$ if $p\in W$. Assume every arrow $a\to b$ with $b$ fibrant factors as $a\xrightarrow{w}a'\xrightarrow{p}b$, where $w\in W$, $p\in P$, and $a'$ is fibrant. No functorial choices are assumed.

Choose coherent localizations $q_f:N\mathcal A_f\to X$ and $q:N\mathcal A\to Y$ at the indicated weak equivalences, meaning that restriction to either nerve, for every target quasicategory, identifies its entire coherent functor category with the full subcategory of functors inverting those weak equivalences. Let $i:N\mathcal A_f\to N\mathcal A$ be inclusion and let $u:X\to Y$ be the induced functor with its natural equivalence $u q_f\simeq q i$.
For every fibrant object $x$, the induced functor
$$T_x:(q_f\downarrow q_f(x))\longrightarrow(q\downarrow q(x))$$
is final. The source has objects $(a,\alpha:q_f(a)\to q_f(x))$ with $a$ fibrant and the target has objects $(b,\beta:q(b)\to q(x))$ with $b$ arbitrary; both retain all coherent triangle data and higher simplices. Explicitly $(v\downarrow z)$ denotes the simplicial pullback
$$K\times_{Z,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,Z)\times_{Z,\operatorname{ev}_1}\{z\}$$
for $v:K\to Z$. The functor $T_x$ uses $i$ on its underlying object and $u$ on its displayed arrow, using $u q_f\simeq q i$ at both ends. A coherent functor $v:K\to L$ is final here if, for every quasicategory $\mathcal E$ and diagram $F:L\to\mathcal E$, restriction along $v$ carries every colimiting coherent cocone to a colimiting coherent cocone with the same apex.
